messages:
Anya: quick intake for psi-8b v1 bring-up — want a fast runtime/compat smoke before we escalate to canary. can someone run basic kv/attn passes + a short eval? link to model bundle: https://hf.co/redwood/psi-8b-v1 :wave:
Kevin: on it. checklist i'm going to follow: 1) artifact sanity (config/tokenizer) 2) load on xPU (cuda11) 3) run forward w/ cache warmup seqs 32/128/512 4) quant q4/q8 smoke 5) deterministic prompt logits diff test
Maria: uploaded early logs from cuda smoke: 
```
[2026-12-01 09:12:08] INFO load model psi-8b v1
[2026-12-01 09:12:14] WARN kv_cache: expected shape (batch=1, heads=32, seq=64, dim=64) got (batch=1, heads=32, seq=128, dim=64)
RuntimeError: KV cache shape mismatch (seq_len=128 vs 64)
```
Maria: this popped when switching between seq=64 and seq=128 in the same session. might be cache indexing or rotary positional handling :thinking_face:
Kevin: hmm, that looks like stale cache isn't being reinitialized on new sequence length. could be our continuous-batching path. adding quick repro script now.
infra-bot: provisioning gpu-pool:psi-smoke-01 -> SUCCESS (pool id p-09ab) :white_check_mark:
Kevin: repro attached: ``run_smoke.sh --model redwood/psi-8b-v1 --seq 64 && run_smoke.sh --seq 128`` reproduces. stack trace points into attn_rotary.cpp line 214 where cos/sin dims differ.
Anya: good find. Maria can you capture raw kv tensors (first 3 tokens) and dump rotary phase multipliers? we want to check if there is a RoPE base mismatch or an off-by-one in position indexing.
Maria: done, uploaded kv-dumps/psi8b-rot-dump.tar.gz. quick diff shows phase at pos=64 doesn't flip sign, which is suspicious.
Kevin: that suggests either model was exported with a different rotary base or our runtime assumes 1-based vs 0-based positions. quick experiment: patch runtime to force position offset 0/1 and rerun.
Maria: ran with +pos_offset=1 -> no error, but outputs deviate (logits delta ~1e-2) on the deterministic prompt test. eval-bot: deterministic prompt results: 
- prompt: "Translate to French: The cat sat on the mat."
- baseline logits hash: abc123
- psi8b v1 (runtime pos_offset=1) logits hash: abd128
- token-level disagreement: 2 tokens different in top-1 at step 7
- ppl change: +0.3
Anya: small but non-negligible. could be safe if instruction-following still holds, but we need to mark as quality regression and decide rollout policy.
Kevin: for quant experiments, I'll run q8 with/without rotary-fix. need to know whether quant kernels expect the same phase scaling.
Maria: also saw a minor perf regression for seq=512: ~12% slower vs baseline (older model). might be cache eviction pattern hitting.
Anya: next steps: 1) add regression test that runs the two-step seq switch (64->128) 2) add deterministic prompt eval to CI 3) kv-dump + rotary phase check added to onboarding checklist 4) decide whether to hotfix runtime (pos offset toggle) or re-export model with adjusted RoPE params. assign owners?
Kevin: i'll take the runtime toggle and q8 smoke. ETA EOD PT.
Maria: i'll own model-side re-export attempt and produce diffed tokenizer/config artifacts.
Anya: thanks — tagging @infra for canary pool when we have a clean pass. if toggle fixes behavior but changes logits we need a canary with traffic shaping and rollback policy. :link:
infra-bot: canary pool request queued, awaiting green tests.
eval-bot: added a regression ticket: EVAL-4273 "psi-8b rotary/kv sequence-switch regression" with baseline traces and dump links.
Anya: perfect. please paste short notes into the onboarding intake doc (onboard/psi-8b-v1.md) and set priority P1 until we confirm no quality drop. :thumbsup:
Kevin: noted. will post quick follow-up with q8 numbers when done.
Maria: thanks — will update thread with re-export artifacts.
